sahneler.metin: A controlled burn in New Mexico escaped and raced toward Los Alamos.
Within days, the fire destroyed homes and labs, leaving hundreds of families homeless.
The burn was meant to reduce fire danger.
It was part of a hazard reduction plan.
High winds pushed it out of control.
Over four hundred families lost their homes.
